basic_profile.bio: I'm a 22-year-old from Austin, Texas, currently juggling college life and a part-time job at a local jewelry store. I'm a newbie in the world of cardistry, always eager to learn new moves and tricks. When I'm not practicing cardistry, I'm working on my rap skills or researching autoimmune disorders due to a family member's condition. My evenings and weekends are dedicated to exploring Reddit, especially subreddits that align with my interests. I'm single and enjoy spending my free time either online or hanging out with a few close friends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My knowledge in cardistry is mostly self-taught, supplemented by online tutorials and community forums. I stumbled upon the art form while looking for unique hobbies and have been hooked ever since. My interest in autoimmune disorders stems from personal research to support a family member. As for music, I've been dabbling in rap as a creative outlet.
